messages:
maria: Heads-up — cost alert from finance: synthetic probes jumped ~3x last 24h after we enabled streaming checks in eu-west. Can we triage?
kevin: I saw that. streaming_handshake_failures spiked and probe retry logic doubled attempts. Looks like our backoff not kicking in for websocket handshakes.
rachel: timeline? did this coincide with the rollout at 02:00 UTC?
maria: yes, rollout at 02:07. probe config changed to 'streaming' probe type + sampling=100% for that region.
jon: sample of logs from probe-bot show repeated 101->timeout loops. snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T02:12:34Z] connect websocket wss://eu-west-stream.redwood.internal/handshake
[2026-03-17T02:12:34Z] recv FIN or timeout after 10s
[2026-03-17T02:12:34Z] retry attempt=1
[2026-03-17T02:12:44Z] retry attempt=2
```
kevin: Prom query for recent 1h: rate(probe_attempts_total{type="streaming",region="eu-west"}[5m]) shows sustained high RPS. Also recording rule probe_stream_handshake_error_rate: increased from 0.5%->6%.
probe-bot: automated-run: created ticket #INC-2891 and posted to incidents.
maria: immediate mitigation options?
rachel: rollback sampling to 10% for streaming in eu-west, and enable adaptive backoff (exponential jitter) in probe agent.
jon: propose changing probe config:
```
kind: blackbox_probe
type: streaming
sampling: 0.1
retries: 2
backoff: exponential
backoff_base_ms: 250
```
kevin: also suggest adding Prometheus recording rule to split handshake errors by failure_reason and to cap alert burn for the SLO dashboard.
maria: SLO impact? our streaming SLO (p99 handshake < 2s) degraded to 2.8s in eu-west, but non-streaming endpoints unaffected.
kevin: cost calc: estimates show eu-west streaming probes were ~1.2M probes/day -> at $0.02 per probe unit we overshot budget by ~$12k/day. Sampling back to 10% saves ~11k/day.
rachel: dashboard work — need a Grafana panel for "probe economic meter" (tokens burned vs cost/day) and a panel for "probe handshake heatmap by AZ".
jon: alert tuning: current page alert: probe_stream_handshake_error_rate > 2% for 5m. That fired repeatedly because of bursty failures. Suggest -> for page alert: > 5% for 10m OR steady >2% for 60m. Keep P2 for 2-5%.
kevin: I'll open PR for Prometheus rules + new recording rule 'probe_stream_handshake_p50/90/99' and add a grafana panel.
probe-bot: deploy plan scheduled: canary rollout of sampling change to eu-west-a only, 02:45 UTC.
deploy-bot: canary started at 02:46 UTC, instances: 3/3 healthy.
maria: after canary we should verify cost delta and handshake rate. monitor for 30m before region-wide.
jon: post-canary metrics (02:46–03:10): handshake_error_rate down from 6%->1.1%, attempts RPS down ~85%.
rachel: cost projection after region-wide switch looks within budget. I'll file follow-up to add telemetry to the probe agent for backoff jitter distribution.
kevin: long-term: add a probe-type gating rule in the console UI so customers can't accidentally enable 100% streaming probes across regions without explicit cost warning.
maria: agree. action items:
- kevin: PR for prometheus + grafana panels (due EOD)
- rachel: telemetry + follow-up ticket for probe agent (due +3d)
- jon: write runbook snippet for streaming probe incidents and backoff config (due tomorrow)
- ops: keep sampling at 10% until PR lands
maria: thanks all, good catch. will update finance and incidents once PR merged. :thumbsup:
